paragraphs: I am a results-driven sales professional with 4 years of experience navigating complex B2B sales cycles across enterprise and startup ecosystems. My work sits at the intersection of SaaS, growth, customer discovery and relationship-led selling.

I enjoy understanding how teams buy, what slows decisions down and how the right product story can create urgency. I bring a structured sales mindset, strong follow-through and the ability to build trust with prospects, customers and internal teams.

items.name: B2B SaaS Sales Development
description: Worked across prospecting, qualification, consultative conversations and stakeholder follow-up for B2B sales cycles.
Built a practical understanding of enterprise and startup buying environments, including how to identify pain points, map needs and move conversations forward.
Focused on clear communication, pipeline discipline and customer-first growth.

items.name: Amazon Career Milestone
description: Recognized publicly by HiveSchool for earning a placement at Amazon after Cohort 2.
Demonstrated ownership through structured learning, focused career preparation and consistent execution.
Used the milestone as a foundation for continued growth in B2B SaaS sales.

items.name: Growth and Customer Conversations
description: Translate customer context into focused sales conversations that are easy to understand and act on.
Bring a balanced approach to outreach: research-led, concise, persistent and respectful of the buyer's time.
Interested in roles and projects where sales, SaaS adoption and business growth come together.
